GStreamer.PathHint: Path to GStreamer installation. Leave empty for auto-detection.
GStreamer.ProxyHint: Supported video (MKV/WebM, and AVI when its transcoding is enabled) in playlists is served through the GStreamer HLS transcode (audio → AAC) so HLS-capable players get compatible audio; other files stream directly.
GStreamer.AudioLangHint: Which audio track the transcode muxes in when the player doesn't pick one explicitly: the container's first track, or the first track tagged with the chosen language.
GStreamer.SourceHint: stream works with any info hash; play uses only torrents already listed in TorrServer.
GStreamer.MaxTasksHint: 0 = unlimited. When the limit is exceeded, the oldest GST task is stopped and removed.
GStreamer.InactiveMinutesHint: After this many minutes without requests, the pipeline is frozen; the next request resumes the task.
GStreamer.AACBitrateKbpsHint: Used only when audio must be transcoded to AAC.
GStreamer.AACChannelsHint: 0 = use the selected audio track probe value; fallback is 2.
GStreamer.AACSamplerateHint: 0 = use the selected audio track probe value; fallback is 48000 Hz.
GStreamer.SegmentSecondsHint: Target duration of one HLS/fMP4 segment.
GStreamer.AppSinkBuffersHint: Queue of ready appsink buffers. Usually leave the default value.
GStreamer.VideoBitrateHint: Used only when video transcoding to H.264 is enabled.
GStreamer.TranscodeHint: When disabled, compatible tracks are copied. Enable for codecs the client cannot play directly.
GStreamer.TempFS: Enable file buffer for source stream
GStreamer.TempFSHint: Creates a temporary gst-XXXXXX ring buffer in the TorrServer working directory. Helps smooth speed drops on weak torrents; SSD storage is recommended.
GStreamer.TempFSRingHint: 0 = base buffer around 90 seconds. Each unit adds roughly 30 seconds; 10 adds about 300 seconds.
GStreamer.SegmentDiffHint: Copy-mode keyframe alignment tolerance; 0 disables the limit. Usually leave unchanged.
GStreamer.SubtitlesHint: Convert supported embedded text subtitles to segmented WebVTT.
GStreamer.HDRToSDRHint: Tone-map PQ/HLG video and transcode it to SDR H.264.
GStreamer.HardwareAccelerationHint: Tests supported GPU encoders once and falls back to x264 when none works.
GStreamer.UseGPUHint: Allows GPU encoding and HDR tone mapping; falls back to CPU when unavailable.
GStreamer.X264UltrafastHint: Reduces CPU load at the cost of quality for the same bitrate.

flow.title: Flow playback
flow.noMetrics: No Flow telemetry is available yet.

healthDescription.HEALTHY: Playable data is cached ahead; the server reports no buffer warning.
healthDescription.MARGINAL: Download is below measured playback demand; the buffer may run out.
healthDescription.BUFFER_RISK: The server reports a buffer warning.
healthDescription.STALLED: The server reports a stalled stream.
healthDescription.WARM_IDLE: Playback disconnected or paused; cached data remains protected for resume.
healthDescription.UNKNOWN: There is not enough playback telemetry to judge buffer health.

troubleshooting.title: Playback troubleshooting
troubleshooting.delivery: The delivery position is the end of bytes sent by the server, not the player’s decoded position. Buffer seconds are estimates.
troubleshooting.estimate: Media bitrate is provisional or unavailable. An optional ffprobe result improves the estimate; variable bitrate still causes variation.
troubleshooting.draining: Measured download is below estimated demand and the buffer is draining. Check swarm peers and the network connection.
troubleshooting.waiting: A server read waited at least 500 ms within the last 60 seconds. This does not prove a player decoding stall.
troubleshooting.idle: No player request is active. The player may be paused, disconnected, or consuming its own buffer.
troubleshooting.peers: No connected peers and no contiguous bytes are available. Check local network readiness and tracker status.
troubleshooting.prepare: Prepare the episode before watching, or choose a smaller release. A larger RAM cache cannot replace missing swarm capacity.

flow.startupTimingHint: Metadata time is measured from torrent registration; other times from preload. A dash means not observed.
flow.sparseUnknown: Availability is unknown or the sample is stale.
flow.sparseQueue: Queued blocks: {{blocks}}; outstanding bytes: {{bytes}}; longest queue: {{ms}} ms
flow.sparseTruncated: Only the first 512 peers were sampled; zero does not establish absence.
flow.sparseHint: Availability describes connected peers in the sampled forward windows. Source counts may overlap. A useful peer holds a needed piece; it may still be slow or choked.

sparseReasons.UNCHOKE: Waiting for a supplier to unchoke us
sparseReasons.CACHE_OR_PROBE: Waiting for local cache or container probe
sparseReasons.FIRST_BLOCK: Waiting for the first required block

flow.privatePolicy: Private torrent: authorized tracker tiers only; public discovery and peer hints are disabled.
flow.connectivityHint: These are observed BitTorrent peer ports, separate from HTTP port 8090. Allow TCP and UDP through your firewall and router. Mapping success alone does not prove external reachability or bypass CGNAT. Keep TCP and uTP enabled where usable; hole punching is conditional. A forwarding-capable VPN is optional. The dashboard does not need Internet exposure.

riskReasons.SUPPLY_DEFICIT: Useful supply is below estimated demand
riskReasons.PIECE_WAIT: Recent reads waited for torrent pieces
riskReasons.BUFFER_DRAINING: The contiguous buffer may run out soon

flow.urgentProgress: Piece {{piece}} · priority {{priority}} · waiting {{unrequested}} · requested {{requested}} · writing {{writing}} · finished {{finished}}/{{blocks}} · receiving {{receiving_bytes}} B · duplicate requests {{duplicate_requests}}
flow.urgentHint: Finished blocks may still await verification. Receiving is part of requested work. This bounded snapshot does not measure request age.
flow.ioHint: Active backend queues, peaks and rejections; process-lifetime completion and latency counters. Latency buckets are upper bounds in microseconds. Queue bytes are transient buffers, not a second cache.
flow.reserveHint: HTTP delivery and indexed byte/time slopes are estimates, not the phone decoder clock. Verified pieces beyond a hole are excluded from contiguous reserve.
flow.serverObservation: Server observations; player playback is not measured.
flow.timelineHint: Server observations on one torrent clock. Values beside events describe their measured operation. Missing events remain unknown; this does not measure player stutters.
flow.playerEvidenceHint: Optional Flow Player report. Import stays in this open dialog; it is not uploaded or applied as a server setting.
flow.playerUnmatched: Session could not be matched; measurements remain separate.
flow.playerClockUnknown: Player clock alignment is unknown; do not infer exact event overlap.
flow.playerUnknown: No player measurements available. Server waits do not establish player stutters.

profileHints.legacy: Retains TorrServer-LT connection behavior. Default until measured comparisons justify a change.
profileHints.conservative: Lowers connection pressure with longer timeouts. May reduce overhead; it does not guarantee better playback.
profileHints.balanced: Moderate connection ramp and timeouts for general use. Compare using your own swarms.
profileHints.aggressive: 100 connection attempts per second and an 80-peer initial boost, with libtorrent's default timeouts. May improve discovery at the cost of churn and overhead.
profileHints.custom: Applies your six custom controls. Zero leaves the corresponding libtorrent setting unchanged.
profileHints.adaptive: Legacy peer settings with bounded VBR demand hints and recent outage reserves. Uses the existing cache and deadline ramp; no automatic profile switching. Not yet proven faster than Legacy.

maintenance.title: Maintenance and recovery
maintenance.exclusions: Portable backups omit credentials, private trackers, paths, posters and custom client data. Support reports also omit names and hashes.
maintenance.dirty: Save or discard your changes before restoring a backup.
maintenance.summary: Merge {{torrents}} library records and {{fields}} settings fields.
maintenance.confirmHint: Stop playback first. The engine restarts; existing credentials and host paths are retained. A protected local recovery backup is saved before applying.
maintenance.memoryHint: Process memory includes native allocations. Cache capacity and the Go memory limit are not a process RAM limit.

settings.historyHint: Save private startup diagnostics locally (up to 4 MiB). No URLs, tokens, media names or client addresses.
settings.dhtHint: Reuse known DHT nodes after a restart. Disabled DHT is always respected.
settings.peerHintsHelp: Optional: keep up to 32 recently useful public peers per torrent for 10 minutes, in private local state separate from diagnostic history. At most 128 torrents are retained. Hints expire after a network change; native reconnect backoff still applies. Private torrents never restore these peers.
settings.rateDeadlinesHelp: Off by default: repeated tests showed mixed seek results. Uses piece size and qualified playback rate for future deadlines; the blocked piece remains immediate.
settings.scarceHintsHelp: Off by default. With a qualified consumption rate, variable delivery and a fresh complete peer sample, advance one piece among the next four by at most one second. Blocked reads remain first. This cannot create missing sources and has no established public-swarm speed advantage.
settings.cacheState: Cache: draft {{draft}} MiB · saved {{saved}} MiB · effective {{effective}} MiB
settings.recovered: Recovered from {{source}}. Apply to repair settings; the damaged original will be retained privately.
settings.needsRestart: These changes restart the torrent engine. You can schedule them for idle playback.
settings.hotApply: These changes apply without restarting the torrent engine.
settings.highBitrateExperimentHelp: Off by default. Compare one switch at a time. These controls preserve cache limits and original quality; they do not guarantee faster playback.
settings.lanHint: Run this page on the phone, using the PC server address. Transfers 16 MiB, stops after 20 seconds, and does not use a torrent. Repeat while idle and while streaming. Browser read gaps include browser scheduling; they do not measure packet loss or decoder stalls.
settings.lanResult: {{rate}} Mbps · first byte {{ttfb}} ms · read-gap p95 {{p95}} ms · maximum {{max}} ms

certificates.title: HTTPS certificates
certificates.startupHint: Start with --ssl to enable HTTPS. Modes and ports require a server restart.
certificates.subject: Subject
certificates.trustHint: Your phone checks trust separately. A self-signed certificate must be trusted on each device. HTTP media is unencrypted.
certificates.draftHint: Save or discard your settings draft and resolve queued changes first.
certificates.flags: Certificate paths are controlled by startup flags.
certificates.fileLimit: Choose both files, each no larger than 1 MiB.
certificates.uploadHint: The key is stored privately on the server. It is never included in downloads or status. Use HTTPS or a trusted local connection for uploads.
certificates.confirmHint: Devices may need to trust the certificate again. Existing connections continue; new handshakes use the new certificate within five seconds.
certificates.saved: Certificate saved. Reload may require accepting the new certificate.
certificates.plainHttp: This page uses plain HTTP. Uploading a private key here sends it unencrypted. Open HTTPS before uploading.

settings.transportHelp: Compare transport sizes with the same fixture and reserves. Existing default: 1024 KiB. Changes apply to new HTTP requests.

runtime.budgetHint: This limits cache eviction, not total process memory. Immediate reader and container data remain protected.
runtime.backgroundLimited: Background work is deferred to protect playback.
runtime.overcommit: Protected reader data exceeds the cache budget.
runtime.uploadBusy: Upload is near the configured cap. Compare playback with a lower upload cap and router SQM. Peer request queues do not measure WAN bufferbloat.
runtime.localExposure: Listener settings do not prove Internet reachability. Keep management on a trusted LAN.
runtime.bindingLimit: Binding pauses torrent networking when the adapter disappears. DNS routing and VPN leak protection remain unverified; use an OS/VPN kill switch for that guarantee.

app.install: You can add this page to your home screen. Installation features vary by browser; streaming works over ordinary LAN HTTP.

preparation.title: Prepare episode
preparation.help: Preparation downloads the selected file into the existing piece store. Verified pieces survive player disconnects and restarts. Quota includes shared boundary pieces. Cancel retains progress; Remove cleans it up after playback stops.
preparation.readyHelp: The entire file is verified and retained, including seek data. Use the playback links above.
preparation.alternative: If sources remain slower than playback, choose a smaller or lower bitrate release in Search or Lampa and add it explicitly. A different release has different bytes and starts a new playback asset. Import the original .torrent to avoid peer metadata waits. Allow uploads within your uplink capacity; saturated uploads can slow acknowledgements.
preparation.unavailable: Preparation is unavailable; check server state and disk space.

sources.title: HTTP mirrors
sources.help: A mirror must supply exactly the torrent’s bytes. Native Range requests, hash checks, retry limits and peer fallback apply. Origins are shown; paths, signed queries and credentials stay out of diagnostics. No provider account is needed.
sources.localHelp: LAN approval permits a literal private or loopback IP without credentials or query arguments. Imported mirrors otherwise require global addresses; DNS results and redirects are checked natively. Proxy-hidden destinations fail closed.

flowHelp.MSXAllowLAN: Off by default. Allows explicitly requested private or loopback IP addresses. Hostnames resolving to LAN and link-local metadata services remain blocked.
